articles.headline: Jayda Clark makes 6 3's, scores 23, and Madison Booker returns as No. 6 Texas beats Green Bay 89-57
articles.description: — Jayda Clark hit six 3-pointers and scored 23 points, and Madison Booker had 12 points and nine rebounds after missing Texas' previous game as the sixth-ranked Longhorns beat Green Bay 89-57 on Wednesday night.

images.name: Jayda Clark highlights No. 6 Texas' chemistry and love for one another
images.caption: Clark recaps her stellar performance of 23 points with six 3-pointers and discusses how the Longhorns played unselfish basketball in the win over Green Bay.

articles.headline: Woolfolk scores 19, Blake 15, No. 11 Vanderbilt women top North Alabama 80-44
articles.description: — Mia Woolfolk scored 19 points, Mikayla Blakes overcame a slow start to add 15 and No. 11 Vanderbilt rolled to an 80-44 win over North Alabama on Wednesday night.
